sentence: This project studies which nutrients the body supplies to lung cancers and how those nutrients affect tumor growth and anticancer immune responses.
This project studies how three mitochondrial proteins affect angiogenic and metabolic pathways in retinal diseases such as diabetic retinopathy.
This project studies how brain circuits from the anterior cingulate to the amygdala and nucleus accumbens shape social choice in a rodent paradigm.
This project offers expertise in bioinformatics and computational tools for analyzing genomic data from cancer research.
This project builds a brain scanner that can join a total-body scanner to image the brain and body together for oncologic disease.
This project studies how losing one protein changes the way the androgen receptor works and drives aggressive prostate cancer.
This project builds an imaging tool that shows many proteins and RNA at once inside large tissue samples.
This project sets up three research cores that give vision researchers facilities and technical support, including ocular imaging and mass spectrometry.
This project studies how an experimental flu vaccine might trigger antibodies that recognize all flu strains now circulating in human populations.
This project studies how innate immunity protects against a hospital-acquired infection.
This project tests whether increasing a post-translational modification protects the noradrenergic system in a transgenic rat model of Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how a checkpoint blockade therapy changes the way B lymphocytes fight tumors in triple negative breast cancer.
This project builds pre-clinical models of glioblastoma to find out which cells it starts from and how it progresses.
This project tests whether everyday gait and physical activity measured with an accelerometer can predict injurious falls in older adults.
This project studies how proteins interact with other proteins to control interferon-driven inflammation, using lung models of overactive interferon signaling.
This project builds an electrochemical test that detects HIV in a blood sample at home.
This project develops simple tools to detect and analyze RNA molecules.
This project studies how a protein called Interferon Regulatory Factor 7 links interferon pathway activation to the fibrotic response in systemic sclerosis.
This project builds computational tools and tests them in stem cells and mouse models to find drugs for Alzheimer's disease.
